name: Mode: King of the Hill
author: Sixth Front
description: One big capture point in the middle of the map, and nothing else. Hold it to drain the enemy's tickets; lose it and yours drain instead. Works on every map: it uses the map's most central capture point. The game restarts when you switch it on or off.
script: // The hill sits on the map's most central capture point
const maps = mm.list.filter((m) => m.enabled && m.id !== api.mod.id && m.hasMap && m.mod.map && Array.isArray(m.mod.map.flags) && m.mod.map.flags.length >= 2);
let spot = { name: 'THE HILL', x: 0, z: 0 };

for (const f of src) if (Math.hypot(+f.x, +f.z) < Math.hypot(spot.x, spot.z) || spot.name === 'THE HILL') spot = { name: String(f.name || 'THE HILL').toUpperCase().slice(0, 20), x: +f.x || 0, z: +f.z || 0 };
f.x = spot.x; f.z = spot.z; f.y = api.heightAt(spot.x, spot.z); f.name = spot.name;
if (eb) eb.textContent = 'KING OF THE HILL  ·  ' + api.config.MAP.name + '  ·  ' + spot.name;
const held = f.owner < 0 ? (f.capturing >= 0 ? `${T[f.capturing].name} TAKING IT` : 'NOBODY HOLDS IT') : `HELD BY ${T[f.owner].name}`;

api.hud.text('koth', `KING OF THE HILL: ${spot.name}  ·  ${held}${f.contested ? '  ·  CONTESTED' : ''}`, { x: 50, y: 17, size: 0.7, color: f.owner < 0 ? '#f2b33d' : f.owner === me ? '#3fa9f5' : '#ff4b3a' });
